recipes.name: Arugula Salad with Cannellini Beans
ingredients_raw: 1 (15 ounce) can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat; cook the garlic in the hot oil about 1 minute. Add the tomatoes, wine, sage, and thyme; increase the heat to medium-high and simmer 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in the cannellini beans and basil. Season with salt and pepper. Continue cooking until beans are heated through, 3 to 4 minutes.
Arrange the arugula on a serving platter. Spoon the bean mixture over the arugula. Top with the shaved Parmesan cheese if desired.

raw_recipe.headline: Arugula Salad with Cannellini Beans
raw_recipe.description: This is a quick and delicious warm salad that can be either a light lunch, or a side dish to a nice steak or pork chop dinner.

review.reviewBody: This humble salad brought back such memories, all of them wonderful and pleasant, of dinners at my Italian grandmother's table. This, to me, was the ultimate comfort food. All the ingredients blend together deliciously to create a taste sensation. Perfect with the arugula, but this could also be tossed with some rigatoni or penne pasta. This is also good enough to eat on its own with a crusty slice of Italian bread for a simple, light, but satisfying meal. I used all fresh herbs from my garden, and beautiful, shaved Parmigiano-Reggiano. Thank you, kimscookingnow, for the delicious memories. I have to say that of the 700+ recipes I've tried from this site, this is by far one of the more memorable. And for what it's worth, my German hubby raved about this too!

This is one of my favorite dishes to make. It has everything you need to make a quick, healthy meal even impressing people because it tastes so sophisticated, like you spent hours making it. It easily adjusts to your kitchen, too. I often use fresh tomatoes and today I used some fresh pesto instead of basil. And, instead of Parmigiano Reggiano, I was able to use up a chunk of Asiago taking up space in the fridge.

Outstanding recipe. I substituted raspberry vinegar for the white wine. I also garnished the entire salad with some chopped up fresh garlic tops before adding the cheese and then drizzled it with some olive oil and raspberry vinegar. A big hit in this Italian home.
Paired it with grilled veal. Added a 1/4 teaspoon of finely chopped red chili pepper.
So simple, and healthful! I used a can of salsa style tomatoes, and it was great!

Seemed to be lacking something. I think mixing the arugula in rather than setting the beans /tomatoes on top would be preferable. I may add bacon or something else with a little different texture next time.
We were both shocked at how good this was. I do love arugula and I used white wine vinegar instead. Used fresh agugula, tomatoes and basil from the garden. Excellent!
Loved it, I didn't have white wine so I substituted apple cider vinegar. It was nice to have a salad and it not be a cold salad!
I will e shopping for the recipe items today. I love cannelin beans and arugula, so does my husband. Good to have a delish summer sode dish. I WILL def let ya know how it turns out.
Great way to use the arugula from my garden and give my vegetarian daughter some protein from the beans. Thanks!
Wonderful side dish, something different besides the usual sides. It's nice to see a new recipe for Arugula too!
This is very tasty and healthy. I added a couple of cups of cooked penne pasta, it makes a great vegetarian meal.
I love arugula and I love beans so I thought I would love this. I even added extra garlic because as far as I'm concerned you can never have enough but this dish just didn't do it for me.
Very easy and tasty. I loved it!

This was SO GOOD! I had some arugula left to use up and stumbled across this one - very earthy and full of flavour, and came together very quickly, another bonus. Thanks for sharing...we really enjoyed this dish :)
Brillant, can't wait to go home and make it for my Italian mother.
